brief:
Israeli occupation forces breached the Gaza ceasefire agreement on Tuesday through demolition operations and intensive gunfire in several areas, Shehab Wire reported. The violations marked a continuation of alleged breaches by Israeli military units operating in the strip.

Occupation machinery remained positioned near populated zones as the operations unfolded. The deployments occurred while the ceasefire framework remained officially in effect across the territory.
